status: author classification; independent cause-coding review pending
cut: All depth-2 disease nodes plus shallower leaves; never combine parent and child.
endpoint: Natural noninfectious underlying-disease groups; cancer/cirrhosis remain target even where remote infectious etiology exists. Infectious triggers of chronic disease are not reassigned.
critical_limit: Compatible top20 is complete within this explicit subset, not a fully resolved strict national top20. Mixed groups are NOT zero or safely excluded.
rank_bounds: Fixed modeled counts and fixed groups; each mixed group target contribution in [0,total]. Excludes WHO statistical uncertainty and redistribution of pandemic residual.
mapping_source_default: WHO methods Annex A; null ICD means not extracted, not absent
